name: uiproof-repair-benchmark
caveats: These patches came from the deterministic stub in e2e/support/stub-model.ts, which answers with the reference fix from benchmark/defects.json. The harness and the pipeline are measured here; a model's ability to fix these defects is not.
Token counts are estimated at four characters per token, not counted by a tokeniser.
No price was supplied (UIPROOF_BENCHMARK_PRICE_PER_MTOK), so no cost is reported — an invented one would be worse than none.
Each scenario runs in container execution: no network, read-only root, dropped capabilities.

scenarios.note: A control nothing names, on a page that also has a contrast failure and a fixed-width banner: the patch has to fix one defect without touching the others.

result.execution: Container execution (docker 29.8.2, image node:24-bookworm-slim): read-only root filesystem, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, 2048 MB memory, 2 CPU(s), 512 process(es), no network interface at all — UIProof reaches the application over a stdio relay.

reasons: Every target defect is gone, no measured route or viewport regressed, and the build and tests passed.
